predecessor.pd15: 32/32 norm-weighted vs 0/32 unweighted on original clustered strong 16D
predecessor.pd16_role: separate weight-permutation-placebo cohort; result kept independent

scientific_question: Does the PD15 norm-weighted advantage depend on radial information about latent support cardinality, when a paired source law preserves the exact support bank and orthogonal true-Q but makes ||x|| independent of support K? Can a fixed label-free angular-ray baseline recover the planted axes under radial camouflage?
independent_unit: one independently seeded 16D Q rotation, tested under both source laws; n=32 independent roots, never treat laws/heldout boards as independent

original.name: original_strong_clustered
original.supports: EXACT PD12 clustered 16D support banks and k=1..4 equal; k>=2 anchored windows probability .85
original.generator: PD15 source_for_seed(seed), which imports PD12 sample_batch

radial_camouflage.name: radial_camouflage
radial_camouflage.supports: EXACT same per-seed PD12 binary train/heldout supports as original; k=1..4 equal with 0.85 anchored cluster
radial_camouflage.amplitudes: for active i, signed B_i with B_i iid Uniform[0.9,1.1], then a_i=R sign_i B_i/sqrt(sum_active B_j²), R iid Uniform[1.0,1.1] per observed pass vector; R independent of S and K
radial_camouflage.exact_independence: ||x||²=R² independent of active-cardinality K in population since Q orthogonal

givens.optimizer: unchanged PD15 fit_basis with λ=0 or 1; labels/Q/target heldout excluded

angular_control.algorithm: label-free sign-invariant collinear-ray frequency among exactly first 1024 training vectors against all 8192; select top 16 mutually separated rays, polar-orthogonalize; abstain if missing any stable ray
angular_control.selection: rank by descending count, ties by ascending training index; first 16 directions with pairwise abs cosine<0.999; require min neighbor count=12; V=U@Vh polar factor
angular_control.budget: O(1024*8192*16) dot products; logged separately; not candidate-budget-matched and not a primary treatment
angular_control.purpose: observed-only feasibility/information comparator to check independent latents remain identifiable when radial information is camouflaged

scoring.original_and_camouflage_heldout: identical support family definitions and physical BPDModel, each with its own source-law amplitude generation
scoring.primary: interaction of norm_givens minus uniform_givens binary complete-mechanism outcomes between original and radial_camouflage for same 32 Q roots
scoring.bootstrap: root-cluster percentile bootstrap of 32 complete paired D_i; lower 2.5% quantile > 0
scoring.secondary: per-law complete recoveries, exact seed-paired McNemar, full support and MSE; angular training cost and transfer across amplitude laws; no separate significance claims

source_math.source_exact_zero_weight: z(v)=P[support(v) ∩ S = ∅] for independently continuous active amplitudes, under original and radial_camouflage
source_math.strict_matching_gap: k1 drawn with probability 1/4 uniformly among 16 coordinates, each singleton Q ray has mass 1/64; any mixed basis row loses at least 1/64 exact-zero mass compared with a matched canonical coordinate; normalized 16-row objective loses at least 1/1024 if any mixed row
source_math.norm_tilt: Original source λ=1 causes P_λ(K=k) proportional to P(K=k)*phi(λ)^k, phi=E[exp(-λ A²)]; radial_camouflage norm R independent of K gives no cardinality tilt
source_math.angular_ray_control: singletons give repeated rays ±Qe_i at training frequency ≈N/64 each, independent of radius; test candidate prefix and rays without true Q
